limitations: Counts parameter pairs rather than geometric isomorphism classes; no Newton polygon or supersingularity assertion; historical priority unverified by external audit.
scientific_integrity: Exact characteristic-five Cartier calculation with inverse-Frobenius twists, genus-four smoothness, elimination on the smooth parameter surface, and independent finite-field point counts. A finding about normalized coefficient pairs; original family and generic Cartier-rank bound are known.
title: Exact \(5\)-rank strata of a cyclic-symmetric genus-four hyperelliptic family
